name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri Volkov's journey in motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the roar of engines at local rally events near his hometown. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. After graduating, Dimitri joined a small touring car team, quickly proving his aptitude for data analysis and problem-solving. His career progressed through various racing series, culminating in his current role as a race engineer with GCK Motorsport.

Dimitri is known for his meticulous approach to car setup, meticulously analyzing telemetry data to identify areas for improvement. He believes in fostering strong communication between the driver and the engineering team, ensuring that the car is perfectly tailored to the driver's preferences. While his technical skills are highly respected, Dimitri's ability to manage the pressures of race weekends and maintain a positive team environment is what truly sets him apart.

He's always looking for the extra edge, the tiny adjustments that can shave tenths of a second off a lap time. Dimitri is not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom, and his willingness to experiment has often led to unexpected breakthroughs. He is known to bring a thermos of strong black tea to every race.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitri is a stout man of average height, with a perpetual look of intense concentration.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having his workstation organized in a specific, almost ritualistic manner.
